label: Step 9 decision rules
declared: 2026-10-15, before any decision run or evaluation. Values chosen from physical reasoning (below), not from results; to be reviewed by the project owner. Any later change must be disclosed in the README.

why.motion_range_m: Decided before Step 9: the motion operating range. Step 8 was evaluated in the 0-3 m and 3-6 m bins; beyond 6 m motion counts as unknown.
why.entry_horizon_s: A walking person (1.4 m/s) covers about 4 m in 3 s, more than the 3 m caution distance, so a crossing person is stopped for before reaching the corridor. Shorter than the Step 8 route horizon (5 s), because constant-velocity prediction degrades with look-ahead.
why.entry_time_step_s: 0.05 s at 1.4 m/s is 7 cm per step, well under the corridor half-width.
why.caution_lateral_m: One arm's length plus a step beside the corridor edge: a person this close can enter the corridor in under 1 s.
why.caution_ahead_m: Distance the robot would cover in about 3 s at a slow warehouse speed of 1 m/s; within the 0-3 m bin where Step 8 motion is best characterised.
why.person_memory_s: A tracked person whose position drops out (occlusion, invalid depth) keeps its latest valid position for 1 s, which is longer than resume_hold_s, so a brief dropout cannot release a STOP on its own.
why.unlocated_person_in_caution_zone: A person detected without a usable position counts as in the caution zone unless its measured distance is beyond caution_ahead_m (prefer unknown over guesses).
why.gesture_min_confidence: Gesture-module outputs below this count as NONE. To be checked against the gesture module's own operating point when the adapter exists.
why.stop_hold_frames: Three consecutive gesture frames rejects single-frame flicker while adding only a few frames of delay to a STOP.
why.move_hold_s: MOVE needs a deliberate gesture: longer than STOP because releasing the robot is the riskier direction.
why.gesture_timeout_s: A gesture not refreshed for 0.5 s is no longer being shown.
why.resume_hold_s: Asymmetric timing: STOP is immediate; MOVE (from any non-MOVE state, including the first start) needs the rule-7 conditions to hold continuously for 1 s.

conventions: Corridor: centreline in travel order; only the part from the robot's projected position onwards counts (robot_xz unknown -> the whole corridor). Its width is max(configured corridor width, required_width_m).
Caution zone: outside the corridor, within caution_lateral_m of its edge, along the next caution_ahead_m of route.
Trusted motion: motion_trusted, a motion label other than unknown / insufficient_history, a velocity, a current position and distance_m <= motion_range_m. Otherwise motion counts as unknown.
Any current STOP gesture (accepted or not yet) cancels every MOVE gesture, so a STOP from one person always overrides a MOVE from another.
Passage: a 'clear' status without a width, or with a width below required_width_m, is treated as unknown / too_narrow; a passage evaluated for a different required width is treated as unknown.
